title: FOMC minutes of the January 25-26, 2028 meeting — the safest D+21 extrapolation this family has filed (January is 20-for-20)
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, stamp 'Last Update: August 19, 2026'), states the convention verbatim -- 'The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision' -- and its note below the 2027 panel gives the meeting as 'January 25-26, 2028'. 2028-01-26 is a Wednesday (computed from 2028-01-01 being a Saturday) and +21 days is Wednesday 2028-02-16. THE JANUARY SUB-CLASS IS PERFECT AND THAT IS THIS SESSION'S OWN PARSE: every meeting block on the live page and on fomchistorical2007.htm ... fomchistorical2020.htm (fourteen pages, HTTP 200 each) was cut at its own boundary before its '(Released ...)' string was paired to it, giving 156 dated releases with a D+21 x 143 / D+20 x 8 / D+22 x 3 / D+23 x 1 / D+19 x 1 lag histogram -- and ALL 20 January meetings 2007-2026 released at exactly D+21, every one of them on a Wednesday, with no exception of any kind. This is the explicit contrast with proposals/fomc-minutes-2027-12-29.from-fomc-2027-12-08.json, which its proposer flagged as the LEAST safe D+21 extrapolation in the family because December's D+21 can land in the Christmas-New Year window; January's D+21 lands in mid-February, and 2028-02-16 clears Presidents' Day (2028-02-21, the third Monday) by five days. 2022 is the exact structural twin: 2022-01-01 and 2028-01-01 are both Saturdays, the 2022 meeting was January 25-26, and its minutes released Wednesday 2022-02-16 -- the same date pair, six years earlier. Filed estimate on two counts, neither of them date doubt: the meeting it minutes is itself estimate (the same page: 'Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it'), and this lane does not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-2028-01-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09), at D+21 from that decision -- outside the +/-5 corridor and filed anyway on the same ground the proposer of this lane's own event used: THE CALENDAR CARRIES NO 2028 ENTRIES, so a reader of fomc-2028-01-26.md looking for the dated horizon after the decision currently finds nothing. Seven sibling ledgers have already settled this class's posture -- read it, do not trade it -- and fomc-minutes-2027-11-17.md and fomc-minutes-2027-12-29.md each measured the index and implied vol against thousands of sessions and refused both; nothing here reopens that. The one thing worth reading these minutes FOR is named in the parent ledger: the January meeting is the Committee's annual organizational meeting, so its minutes carry the roster change (2028 voters New York, Cleveland, Boston, St. Louis, Kansas City) and the annual review of the Statement on Longer-Run Goals. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED; the impact tier is inherited, not measured: medium matches every other fomc-minutes-* entry. symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
